# MDD Sim Gateway v1.12.0-rc1

## 中文

### 0. 重要更新说明

- **这是预发布版本，不是正式版。**它的目的是在实机上真正跑一遍全容器部署的一键更新与整组
  回滚：这两条路径在此之前没有任何可升级的旧容器版本，因此从未被真实执行过。请在可以承受
  中断的环境验证，验收通过后再发布正式版。
- **自动更新通道保持 v1.9.5 不变。**发布记录更新到 v1.12.0-rc1，但已在运行的网关不会自动
  升级到本版本，需要手动选择安装。
- **NAS 全容器部署为实验特性。**Release 尚未提供任何可安装的驱动资产；宿主缺少内核驱动时，
  Hardware 容器会保持 unhealthy 且 Control 不会启动，当前版本没有页面上的驱动预检提示。
  已实现与未实现的边界见[全容器版本发布方案](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/main/docs/design/container-release-plan.md)的「实现状态」一节。
- **树莓派与普通 Linux 的原生安装方式不变，默认端口仍是 8443。**容器部署在宿主使用
  `10443`，容器内仍监听 8443。

### 1. v1.12.0-rc1 本次小版本更新

**NAS 全容器部署**

- **以前网关必须在宿主安装 pcscd、ModemManager 和 NetworkManager，NAS 上无法这样做。**现在
  Control、Hardware、Egress 三个基础容器加每条启用线路一个 Engine（`3 + N`）即可运行：
  Hardware 在容器内运行私有 D-Bus、ModemManager、NetworkManager、pcscd 与 SIM bridge，
  宿主不安装任何项目软件。NetworkManager 只接管 `wwan*`、`cdc-wdm*`，蜂窝配置一律
  never-default，NAS 默认路由不变。
- **国家出口以前需要在宿主创建 TUN 并写入 ePDG 路由，这在 NAS 上既不安全也会与现有网段
  冲突。**Egress 改为每个国家提供一个 SOCKS5 TCP/UDP 入口，从不安装宿主路由；Engine 的
  SWu 为 IKE/500 与 NAT-T/4500 分别建立 SOCKS5 UDP 关联，代理模式下不会回退直连。
- **群晖 Container Manager 用户不需要 SSH 执行安装脚本。**Release 附带写死本版本镜像标签的
  Compose 项目文件，改掉文件开头的示例 LAN 地址即可创建项目。部署步骤见
  [全容器部署指南](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/main/docs/CONTAINER_DEPLOYMENT.md)。

**容器部署的更新与回滚**

- **容器部署此前只能手工改 Compose 里的镜像标签再重建。**现在网页一键更新会由当前 Control
  镜像启动一个一次性助手：它先按 Release `SHA256SUMS` 校验四个镜像归档，备份数据库和配置，
  只替换 Compose 中的四处镜像引用而保留其余修改，再重建三个基础容器并逐条滚动 Engine。
  任一阶段失败会自动恢复上一份 Compose、基础镜像和更新前的 Engine 镜像。助手完成后自删，
  不增加常驻容器。
- **Release 资产从两种镜像扩展为四种。**amd64 与 arm64 都在原生 runner 构建 Control、
  Hardware、Egress、Engine，逐个核对架构、组件与版本标签，发布八个离线镜像包、版本化
  Compose 文件和四个 GHCR 多架构标签，统一写入同一份 `SHA256SUMS`。

**所有部署都会看到的变化**

- **在硬件页保存读卡器线路的 IMEI 后，还需要再到 SIM 页保存一次线路才会启动。**现在保存
  这最后一项缺失信息会直接把草稿转正并启动线路。
- **端口块分配过去只探测三个服务端口，RTP 冲突要等旧 Engine 已被替换才暴露。**现在探测
  候选块内的全部端口。容器部署跳过这项探测，因为 Control 看不到宿主命名空间，冲突由
  Docker 在创建 Engine 时报告。

### 2. 已知限制

- 更新门槛只到容器健康检查：助手不校验 IMS 是否重新注册、NAS 默认路由是否一致、
  NetworkManager 接管范围是否正确。
- 新增或移除蜂窝模块会重启容器内的 pcscd，已运行线路会出现一次短暂的 SIM 通道中断。
- 尚未验证：DSM 冷启动后驱动与整套服务自动恢复、ARM64/树莓派上的全容器路径、真实运营商
  条件下的容器化蜂窝短信、USSD、通话、MMS 与 eSIM profile 切换。

## English

### 0. Important notes

- **This is a release candidate, not a final release.** Its purpose is to exercise the container
  deployment's one-click update and whole-stack rollback on real hardware: until now there was no
  older container release to upgrade from, so neither path had ever actually run. Validate it
  where an interruption is acceptable, then publish the final release.
- **The automatic update channel stays on v1.9.5.** Running gateways will not upgrade to this
  version on their own; installing it is a manual choice.
- **The NAS full-container deployment is experimental.** No installable driver asset is published
  in any Release yet. When the host lacks a kernel driver, the Hardware container stays unhealthy
  and Control never starts — this release has no on-screen driver preflight. See the "实现状态"
  section of
  [the container release plan](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/main/docs/design/container-release-plan.md)
  for exactly what is and is not implemented.
- **Native Raspberry Pi and Linux installs are unchanged and still default to port 8443.** The
  container deployment publishes `10443` on the host while Control still listens on 8443 inside.

### 1. What is new in v1.12.0-rc1

**NAS full-container deployment**

- **The gateway used to require pcscd, ModemManager and NetworkManager on the host, which a NAS
  cannot provide.** It now runs as three base containers — Control, Hardware, Egress — plus one
  Engine per enabled line (`3 + N`). Hardware runs a private D-Bus, ModemManager, NetworkManager,
  pcscd and the SIM bridge inside the container, and the host installs nothing. NetworkManager
  manages only `wwan*` and `cdc-wdm*`, every cellular profile is never-default, and the NAS
  default route is unchanged.
- **Country exits previously needed a host TUN and ePDG routes, which is neither safe on a NAS nor
  free of subnet collisions.** Egress now serves one SOCKS5 TCP/UDP listener per country and never
  installs a host route. The Engine's SWu opens separate SOCKS5 UDP associations for IKE/500 and
  NAT-T/4500 and never falls back to a direct path in proxy mode.
- **Synology Container Manager users no longer need SSH or an install script.** Each Release ships
  a Compose project file pinned to that release's image tags; replace the example LAN address at
  the top of the file and create the project. See
  [the container deployment guide](https://github.com/MddIdd/mdd-sim-gateway/blob/main/docs/CONTAINER_DEPLOYMENT.en.md).

**Updating and rolling back a container deployment**

- **A container deployment could previously only be updated by hand-editing image tags in
  Compose.** The web one-click update now launches a short-lived helper from the running Control
  image: it verifies four image archives against the Release `SHA256SUMS`, backs up the database
  and configuration, replaces only the four image references while preserving every other edit to
  the Compose file, recreates the three base containers and rolls the Engines one line at a time.
  Any failing stage restores the previous Compose file, base images and pre-update Engine images.
  The helper deletes itself and adds no permanent container.
- **Release assets grew from two image kinds to four.** Control, Hardware, Egress and Engine are
  each built on a native amd64 and arm64 runner, checked for architecture, component and version
  labels, and published as eight offline archives, a version-pinned Compose file and four
  multi-architecture GHCR tags, all covered by a single `SHA256SUMS`.

**Changes every deployment will see**

- **Saving a reader line's IMEI on the hardware page still required a second save on the SIM tab
  before the line would start.** Saving that last missing fact now promotes the draft and starts
  the line.
- **Port-block allocation only probed three service ports, so an RTP collision surfaced after the
  previous Engine had already been replaced.** It now probes every port in the candidate block.
  Container deployments skip the probe, because Control cannot see the host namespace; Docker
  reports the conflict when it creates the Engine.

### 2. Known limitations

- Update gates stop at container health checks. The helper does not verify IMS re-registration,
  that the NAS default route is unchanged, or NetworkManager's device scope.
- Adding or removing a cellular module restarts the container's pcscd, so running lines see one
  brief SIM-channel interruption.
- Not yet validated: driver and full-stack recovery after a DSM cold start, the full-container
  path on ARM64/Raspberry Pi, and containerised cellular SMS, USSD, calls, MMS and eSIM profile
  switching under real carrier conditions.
